The '''GALAAR-15''' was a heavy [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] in production by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FLT" /> The origins of the carbine's name could be found in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]], specifically the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''galaar'', which translated to "[[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawk]]" in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

[[Kad Solus/Legends|Kad Solus]], a young Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] from [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]], carried a GALAAR-15 and made use of the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] carbine in combat.<ref name="FLT" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The GALAAR-15 blaster carbine was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="FLT" />
